intent: Kanban task detail panel: click task card to open Dialog with full task fields, linked calendar event if set, finance section (finance.read only) with entries and prefilled Add entry; drag-safe.
summary: Implemented PSI-109. Extended updateTaskAction in kanban/actions.ts to accept column_id for moving columns from the edit dialog. Added getTaskFinanceEntriesAction in finance/actions.ts: gated by finance.read, queries finance_entries for task_id = taskId with board/category resolution. Built TaskDetailDialog (task-detail-dialog.tsx) editing title, description, priority, column, due_date; renders Linked Event banner linking to /dashboard/calendar when board.event exists; renders Finance section with entries (amounts in formatIDR) and 'Add entry' button (reusing EntryFormDialog prefilled with board+task) only when canReadFinance (absent otherwise). Wired drag-safe click detection on TaskCard (measures pointer down/up displacement against a 6px threshold so dragging does not open the dialog). 4 unit tests in task-detail.test.ts. Gates: 64/64 frontend tests, 15/15 edge fns, tsc clean, oxlint 0/0.

changes.note: TaskDetailDialog with edit fields, linked event banner, and finance entries section
4 unit tests for updateTaskAction and getTaskFinanceEntriesAction

decisions.decision: Drag-safe click via pointerdown/up displacement threshold (6px)
decisions.reason: TaskCard acts as a dnd-kit draggable handle (asHandle); a plain onClick fires on drag release, so measuring delta ensures genuine clicks only.

decisions.decision: Task detail uses Dialog rather than Sheet
decisions.reason: Maintains consistency with every existing form in the app (NewTaskDialog, EntryFormDialog, CategoryDialog).

decisions.decision: Finance section is omitted entirely from DOM when !canReadFinance
decisions.reason: AC explicitly states 'absent, not empty, for a caller without finance.read' to prevent leaking metadata.

verification.manual: bun test src/ 64/64 (4 new task-detail tests), bun test supabase/functions 15/15, tsc --noEmit clean, oxlint 0 warnings 0 errors.

follow_ups.note: Browser walkthrough: click task card to edit, verify linked event redirection, add task-scoped finance entry, test drag-drop without accidental dialog triggers.
